summary.text: Angie Carraway is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 89 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A public school teacher, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her campaign focuses on public education, affordability and civic engagement.

paragraphs.text: Angie Carraway earned a high school diploma from Morgantown High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of North Texas in 2011 and a graduate degree from Western Governors University in 2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Carraway said she worked in the restaurant industry before finishing her degree, began teaching in 2012, and has lived in Collin County for 25 years.
She described herself as a fifth-generation Hispanic Texan and said she and her husband have raised four children.
Carraway advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
In the survey, she said she supports adding $1,000 to the Basic Student Allotment and opposes school vouchers.
